resources.string: Enter the address of your pesa-tracker. On a home PC it is the \"Other devices on this Wi-Fi\" address shown in the pesa-tracker window, for example http://192.168.0.102:8765.\n\nAfter you log in, M-Pesa messages on this phone are recorded in your account automatically.
Couldn\'t find pesa-tracker at %1$s. Check the address, that pesa-tracker is running, and that this phone is on the same Wi-Fi.
Can\'t reach pesa-tracker at %1$s right now. Is it running, and is the phone on the same Wi-Fi? M-Pesa messages are kept and sent later. Tap Connect to try again.
M-Pesa linked to %1$s. New M-Pesa messages are recorded automatically.
M-Pesa linked to %1$s. Sending %2$d M-Pesa messages from the last 90 days.
pesa-tracker needs SMS permission to detect M-Pesa messages. Allow it in the app\'s settings.
Sending %1$d M-Pesa messages from the last 90 days. Ones already recorded are skipped.
